name: Stillwater's First League Season
oneLiner: Stillwater has never run a league, so there is no last season to show you — this one is being drawn up from scratch on four bays in the east metro.
beginnerNote: Everyone in this league will be new to a Stillwater league, because so is Stillwater. Handicaps even the golf out, and nobody keeps score of your warm-up.
nextSeasonNote: Nights, format, length and price are all still being worked out — we are not sitting on a schedule, we are writing one. Join the list and you will see it the day it is finished.
